note: EMPTY ON PURPOSE. Ron and Friends 2026 is a REDRAFT — every player goes back in the pool and nobody is kept. This file is the input to the keeper overlay that pre-places keepers on the board (src/lib/keeper-overlay.ts), so an empty `declarations` list is what makes the board render 140 open cells instead of pre-filling some of them.
whyTheFileStillExists: The league intends to move to keepers in a future season and the keeper machinery is deliberately kept on disk and importable. Deleting this file would break the readers; emptying it is what turns keepers off in the data, which is the layer that actually decides what lands on the board.
howToAddOne: Add an object to `declarations` with `managerShortName` (the SHORT name from data/managers.json, never a first name if two managers ever share one) and `players` (an array of player names as spelled in data/smartdraft-players.json).
Never write a cost round here. It is derived — see below.
Re-run `npm run build:board` if the board shape also changed, then reload the board.
